decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Murktide Regent to generate card advantage and maintain pressure. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells like Lightning Bolt, and disruptive elements like Wasteland, the deck aims to control the game tempo and close out the match before the opponent can stabilize. It is designed to be fast, aggressive, and efficient in Legacy 1 vs 1 matchups.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a horde of aggressive Goblin creatures, leveraging cards like Goblin Rabblemaster, Muxus, Goblin Grandee, and Legion Warboss to quickly build a threatening board presence. The deck also includes mana acceleration cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to power out its threats ahead of schedule. Additionally, disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Unlicensed Hearse help to control the game state and protect the Goblin army. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. Using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Wasteland to slow down the opponent, while utilizing efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition to maintain board presence and control. Aether Vial allows for explosive creature plays, while cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Flickerwisp provide flexibility and utility. By combining disruption and aggression, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption and removal spells while generating card advantage through cards like Sylvan Library and Once Upon a Time. It aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent with cards like Reanimate and Opposition Agent, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and efficiently disrupting opponents. The key idea is to use aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Questing Druid to apply pressure early on, while utilizing cards like Force of Will and Daze to counter and disrupt opponent's plays. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat in the mid to late game. The deck also includes removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. Wasteland helps control opponents' mana sources, while Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm provide card advantage and deck manipulation.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, and Trinisphere to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The inclusion of Magus of the Moon and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance further punishes opponents who rely on nonbasic lands. The deck's high mana curve and aggressive strategy make it a potent threat in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of lands and various spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Wasteland, and Sphere of Resistance to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan. The deck also includes cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to generate a powerful threat. Crucible of Worlds and Life from the Loam provide recursion for lands that are sacrificed or destroyed. Overall, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outmaneuver the opponent with its land-based strategy.

The main concept of this deck is utilizing the combo of Reanimate and Entomb to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection and consistency. Additionally, Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides a versatile creature that can support the game plan. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently bring out key creatures and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent while deploying threats that can quickly close out the game. It includes a mix of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Stifle, along with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Hooting Mandrills. The deck aims to control the game through countermagic and land destruction, while also pressuring the opponent's life total with its creatures. It has a strong tempo aspect, aiming to disrupt the opponent's plans and win the game swiftly.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while putting pressure on the opponent with evasive threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck utilizes powerful cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistent draws and card selection. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Force of Will and Daze provide protection and interaction. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Questing Druid adds additional threats and versatility to the deck.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Mother of Runes to slow down the opponent, while Stoneforge Mystic and Solitude provide additional threats. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for cheating creatures into play and Recruiter of the Guard helps find key pieces. With access to powerful sideboard options through Yorion, Sky Nomad, the deck can adapt to various matchups and maintain a consistent game plan of disrupting the opponent's resources while advancing its own board presence.

This deck utilizes lands to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan. It focuses on generating value through recurring lands with Life from the Loam, while also using cards like Wasteland and Sphere of Resistance to disrupt the opponent's plays. The deck can assemble the powerful Thespian's Stage and Dark Depths combo to create a lethal 20/20 Marit Lage token. It also includes various utility lands like Ghost Quarter and Karakas to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through strategic land plays and disruptive elements.

This control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while gradually building up resources and card advantage. The deck utilizes counter spells like Force of Will and Daze to interact with the opponent's spells, while also having removal options like Swords to Plowshares. Card selection is crucial in this deck, with Ponder and Brainstorm helping to find the right answers. The deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Triumph of Saint Katherine to close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing control over the board by utilizing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponent's strategies with cards like Daze and Force of Will. It also utilizes efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a strong mix of card draw and mana fixing, the deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory through efficient plays and smart decision-making. It's a fast-paced, proactive deck that aims to dictate the pace of the game and come out on top.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage, countering spells, and removing threats while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. It aims to manipulate the opponent's hand size and draw abilities while maintaining a board presence with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict. The deck also includes cards like Back to Basics and Dress Down to disrupt the opponent's strategy and limit their options. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a win through superior card advantage and control.

The main objective of this Goblin aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Rabblemaster, Muxus, Goblin Grandee, and Legion Warboss, the deck aims to flood the board with powerful Goblin creatures that can quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Cards like City of Traitors and Simian Spirit Guide provide additional mana acceleration to get the Goblins out faster, while Chalice of the Void helps disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on speed and aggression to secure a swift victory.
